_about: James Orr (1844-1913), United Presbyterian, then United Free Church professor in Glasgow, defender of orthodoxy and general editor of the International Standard Bible Encyclopaedia: The Christian View of God and the World, the Kerr Lectures (New York: Randolph, 1893); The Progress of Dogma, the Elliot Lectures (London: James Clarke; preface dated Glasgow, 1901); God's Image in Man (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1905); The Problem of the Old Testament (New York, 1906); The Virgin Birth of Christ (New York: Scribner, 1907). All published before 1930. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

orr-christian-view-1893: The Christian View of God and the World, the Kerr Lectures (New York: Randolph, 1893)
orr-progress-of-dogma-1901: The Progress of Dogma, the Elliot Lectures (London: James Clarke, 1901)
orr-gods-image-in-man-1905: God's Image in Man and its Defacement in the Light of Modern Denials (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1905)
orr-problem-old-testament-1906: The Problem of the Old Testament considered with reference to recent criticism (New York, 1906)
orr-virgin-birth-1907: The Virgin Birth of Christ (New York: Scribner, 1907)
